allowed_statement: MGL can be described with a bounded claimed-author source construction; its paper is still unread and exact publication/runtime/operator equivalence unresolved. ACM403 cannot be used as negative novelty evidence.
closest_ancestry: Training-only auxiliary graph-generator learning through a current virtual parameter-gradient step and downstream graph recommendation; adaptation-free prediction function. Component/source ancestry, not a certified full active-operator match.
event_kind: First bounded public author-implementation semantic scope associated with a known metadata-only paper lead
implementation_qualification_limits: state_dict virtual bases default to detached tensors; create_graph retains the support-gradient path, not an identity base path.
Normal encoder has ReLUs; q_link_predict fast encoder has two affine maps without them. Virtual/deployed map parity fails at source level.
Public tree has model.py but train.py imports models; best_checkpoint is referenced but has no assignment in the parsed training script. Runtime is unqualified.
Primary manuscript and publication-to-source correspondence unverified; no program execution or numerical derivative qualification performed.

one_supported_configuration_gap.MGL_source: Temporary plain-gradient encoder response and one global Adam outer commit.
one_supported_configuration_gap.active_operator: Current private Adam response conditional on old route parameters/moments, shared commit, then recomputed private commitment from the old state.
one_supported_configuration_gap.name: Persistent private-state and commitment coupling

source_roles.commitment: Global outer Adam commits persistent model parameters. Temporary fast weights are not assigned to persistent private state; no post-shared recomputed private inner commitment.
source_roles.deployment: predict(user_id) uses ordinary generator weights, generated item links and graph propagation to return one score matrix, with no support-label/optimizer adaptation step. Evaluation body masks TRAIN history. Actual deployment execution is unverified.
source_roles.differentiation: Support autograd.grad has create_graph=True. Temporary fast weights are state_dict base tensors minus local_lr times support gradient; query graph-ranking loss plus generator regularizer is backpropagated through current support gradient. Inner step is plain gradient, not Adam; the state_dict bases are detached under standard PyTorch default semantics. Full active/operator derivative equivalence not established.
source_roles.optimizer_state: One global Adam is created before epochs and batch loops and stepped after outer backward; source carries its ordinary state if executed. No private inner Adam states, reset/carry histories or optimizer-state differentiation appear in this scope.
source_roles.shared_fast_roles: One persistent generator and user/item embedding model. Only generator-encoder weights/biases form four temporary fast tensors; no bank of four predictors/private learners.
source_roles.support_query: Item-cooccurrence support from TRAIN interaction matrix R^T R with source proposed masking; support MSE includes random false items. Query batch is TRAIN user-positive-negative triples, with negatives rejected if they are in that user train-positive set. No positive/negative endpoint-union eligibility or independently disjoint support/query fold is specified.
